[[File:EdictofJiaan.jpg|200px|thumb|''The Edict of Jiaan'' was banned by Imperial authorities.]]
'''''The Edict of Jiaan''''' was one of two successful but damaging documentaries written by [[Armennion Ullgusta]] and rumored to have been produced by [[Pret Swain]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Its contents included many details of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purge]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. This led to Ullgusta being on the most-wanted list of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and ''The Edict of Jiaan'' being banned within the Empire.
